t: In front of you is the memorial to Emmeline Pankhurst and her daughter Christabel, at the entrance to Victoria Tower Gardens, just south of the Victoria Tower at the corner of the Palace of Westminster. The main feature is the bronze statue of Emmeline by Arthur George Walker, unveiled in 1930. In 1958 it was moved here, and the bronze reliefs honouring Christabel were added. Emmeline organised the British suffragette movement and helped women win the vote in 1918. Christabel co-founded the Women's Social and Political Union and founded The Suffragette newspaper. Both were leading suffragettes.
